answer: With a Registered domain bound by challenge-response signature with one identity per channel, the account is only as strong as its binding: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The record keeps every pearl visible, so anyone can audit the binding roll. The spiral hides nothing and the whisper reveals everything: the binding trail is open to all.
